**Items:** Longsword, Shield, Potion of Healing, and Torches (item ID 23 — the code's own comment mistakenly calls it "Rations," a known bug, [bugs.md B-09]).

**Where defined:** `worker/src/services/character.ts`, in `CLASS_STARTING_ITEMS` (line 65-72): `Fighter: [2, 15, 17, 23]`. These numeric IDs map to seed rows in `worker/src/db/seed.sql` (item 2 = Longsword, 15 = Shield, 17 = Potion of Healing, 23 = Torches). The function `grantStartingEquipment(db, characterId, cls)` (same file, ~line 74) inserts them into `character_inventory`, and it's called from `createCharacter()` during character creation (see `worker/src/services/character.md`, routed from `worker/src/routes/character.md`).
